features.title: Folder Projects
features.body: Keep lyrics and audio together in a project folder with a project.json manifest, recent projects, and workspace scanning. Ctrl+S saves the whole project. Linked projects keep your files where they are instead.
features.info: Enable it under Settings > Files & Storage > Projects in the desktop app, then open File > Projects. Loading lyrics together with audio offers to create a project. It stays off by default.

features.title: Guided Beginner Workflow
features.body: Learn the complete workflow in-app with focused, state-aware steps using your own song, then move the guide or tuck it into a compact edge tab while you work.
features.info: The guide walks through audio import, lyric review, timing, credits, export, and local testing. Contextual ribbon controls reveal advanced options only when they are relevant.

features.title: Compact Lyric Workspace
features.body: Use the full editor width with edge-to-edge audio and lyric areas, connected word groups, and compact count-scaled whitespace chips.
features.info: Adjacent words without a space join visually, including their romanization. Appearance settings can restore the legacy Space xN labels.

features.title: Discord Rich Presence
features.body: Optionally share the current file or track, editor mode, line progress, playback status, and live timeline from the desktop app. Per-project elapsed time persists across app restarts, while website presence uses a reliable PreMiD bridge.
features.info: Enable Discord Rich Presence under Settings > General > Privacy in the Tauri desktop app. It stays disabled by default and requires the Discord desktop client.

features.title: Combine Words Across Lyrics
features.body: Preview a word combination, apply it to matching sequences throughout the lyrics, and optionally ignore case and surrounding punctuation.
features.info: Select adjacent words and open Combine Words. Review the preview, then combine only that occurrence or every matching sequence in the project.

features.title: Header-Free Timing Tools
features.body: Copy line and word timings onto existing lyrics or snap any selected timing block to the playhead without relying on imported Genius headers.
features.info: Select the source and target lines in Edit or Time mode to copy timings, or select a timed block and snap its first timestamp to the current playhead.

features.title: Remembered Desktop Window
features.body: Restore the previous window size, maximized state, and fullscreen state when reopening the desktop app.
features.info: Window state is restored automatically on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Position, visibility, and decorations are intentionally not persisted.

features.title: Inline Time-Tab Editing
features.body: Double-click a synced word to edit it directly in Time mode, or edit its per-word romanization when displayed.
features.info: In Time mode, double-clicking a word opens an inline text box to make immediate corrections without switching tabs.

features.title: TTML Checklist
features.body: Keep a persistent local queue of songs to sync, complete with notes, status tracking, and history.
features.info: Access TTML Checklist from the tools menu to organize your pending lyrics sync tasks and keep notes.

features.title: Smarter Lyrics Splitting
features.body: Choose dedicated syllabification engines for English, Polish, Spanish, French, German, Indonesian, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, and CJK lyrics, with legacy fallbacks still available.
features.info: Open Auto Segment to get a language-based engine suggestion before applying it to all lyric lines. Advanced Segmentation exposes the same alphabetized engine list.

features.title: Learned Word Splits
features.body: Remember manual split boundaries and automatically reuse them whenever the same word appears again.
features.info: In the Split Word dialog, enable remembering to save the boundaries you chose. Matching words use that split during future automatic segmentation.

features.title: Persistent Split Options
features.body: The Split Word dialog remembers the last options you used, so repeated corrections take fewer clicks.
features.info: Your Apply to all, case-sensitivity, and remember-split preferences persist between Split Word sessions.

features.title: Spicy Lyrics Preview
features.body: A high-fidelity Spicy Lyrics renderer with animated, custom, and cover-art backgrounds; karaoke, Simple Lyrics, and line-synced layouts; automatic scrolling; and an optional FPS counter.
features.info: Choose Spicy from the Preview mode selector. It includes interlude dots, RTL- and duet-aware layouts, plus CJK and romanized word wrapping.

features.title: Time Stretch
features.body: Scale every TTML timestamp to fit a new song duration, with support for reading durations from audio files.
features.info: Open Edit > Time Stretch. Set or import the old and new audio durations, then apply the calculated scale factor to the project.

features.title: Unified Lyrics Import
features.body: Choose Plain Text, LRCLIB, Lyrically, or Genius from clear cards in the empty editor, then use one consistent preparation, replacement-confirmation, and formatting workflow.
features.info: Use the import screen as usual. Punctuation, CJK/Latin boundaries, word separators, and background vocals are handled consistently across supported sources.

features.title: Genius Header Categorization & Section Tools
features.body: Preserve headers such as [Chorus] and [Verse] as color-coded section metadata, with whole-section timing controls.
features.info: Enable categorization during a Genius import or when prompted after a text import. In Sync mode, section headers can snap the section to the playhead or copy timing from an earlier matching section.

features.title: Backup & Restore
features.body: Export and restore selected settings, keybindings, appearance assets, projects and history in a portable backup file.
features.info: Open Settings > Backup to select the data to export or restore. Importing replaces the selected existing data and reloads the app.

features.title: Bouncy Word Indicator
features.body: Long-duration syllables in Sync mode get a subtle bouncing dot, making held words easier to spot while timing.
features.info: The CSS-only indicator appears automatically for qualifying words in Sync mode and hides while playback is active.

features.title: Toxi Lyrics Engine
features.body: High-fidelity jump-down animations, instant-on bloom with smooth fade-out, and adjustable wipe softness.
features.info: Located in the Preview tab. Controls under Appearance > Preview allow adjusting wipe softness and bloom.

features.title: 144Hz+ Rendering
features.body: Dedicated interpolation engine for ultra-high refresh rates, bypassing React bottlenecks.
features.info: Automatically active. Ensures lyrics move smoothly regardless of your monitor's refresh rate.

features.title: Millisecond Precision Sync
features.body: Interpolated high-resolution performance markers for frame-accurate timing.
features.info: Interpolates audio position between browser updates to achieve 1ms precision. Found in Sync mode.

features.title: Cinematic Backgrounds
features.body: Hardware-accelerated Mesh Gradient backgrounds running at 60 FPS for a premium, alive-feeling UI.
features.info: Change in Appearance > Background. Supports both static images and dynamic gradients.

features.title: Snap to Playhead
features.body: One-click synchronization that snaps lyric start times directly to the audio playhead position.
features.info: In Sync mode, press 'Enter' or the 'Record' button to snap the current line to the music's current time.

features.title: Auto-Lyric Sanitizer
features.body: Automatically strips Genius tags and cleans empty lines on import.
features.info: Filters out strings like [Chorus] or [Verse] and removes whitespace automatically when importing lyrics.

features.title: Automatic Multilingual Phonetics
features.body: Generate contextual Japanese, Mandarin, and Korean romanization, including per-word readings and mixed-language line mapping.
features.info: Select lyric lines or words and use Romanization in the Edit ribbon. Mandarin readings keep tone marks and map contextual readings onto individual Han characters.

features.title: Pre-Export Validator
features.body: Real-time scan for untimed or overlapping lyrics before saving.
features.info: Runs a diagnostic check when you click Export, highlighting lines that are missing timestamps or have timing conflicts.

features.title: Integrated Audio Bridge
features.body: Built-in FFmpeg.wasm for high-fidelity MP3 to FLAC conversion to eliminate decoding drift.
features.info: Triggered when importing non-standard audio formats. Converts them to high-quality FLAC/MP3 for better compatibility.

features.title: Appearance Editor
features.body: Over 40 granular visual parameters and theme presets to fully customize your editor's look.
features.info: Access via the Settings icon > Appearance. Customize everything from colors to border radius.

features.title: Global Localization
features.body: Full i18n support with community-driven translations.
features.info: Switch languages in Settings > General. Currently supporting English, Chinese, and more via Crowdin.

features.title: Community Plugin Store
features.body: Integrated store to browse and install community-made WASM importers and exporters.
features.info: Open via the 'Plugins' tab in the Ribbon Bar to expand the tool's import/export capabilities.

enhancements.title: Smart BG Vocal Grouping
enhancements.body: Unified scaling for main and background lines.

enhancements.title: Refined .ttml Writer
enhancements.body: Optimized metadata handling and cleaner XML output.

enhancements.title: Modernized UI
enhancements.body: Unified glassmorphism and improved layout stability.
